note: Wall-clock measurements of one e2e run in headless Chromium (SwiftShader), ms: estimates, not benchmarks.

offlineStartMs.what: installed app, offline with the host down: navigation until the stored bracket is regenerated

scriptRunMs.what: the bolt-circle script (8, then 12 holes): regen time of the scripted feature, and wall clock from OK or Run scripts to the built body

viewerLoadMs.what: a share link opened in a new browser context until the bracket is shown (page load, download from the server, unpack, first render)

syncRoundTripMs.what: a rename in one browser until the other shows it (push, server, other browser)

rebase100PendingMs.what: back online with 100 queued commands until the server confirmed all of them (hello, rebase over 1 entry, push)
